## Your Morning Business Digest

Every morning, one clean email with the numbers that matter - yesterdays revenue, new customers, and a plain-English read on the day - pulled from Stripe automatically. Stop opening five dashboards.

### Setup (8 min)
1. Edit CONFIG: paste a Stripe RESTRICTED key (read-only: Charges + Customers), your OpenAI key, and your timezone.
2. Set the Schedule node to your wake-up time.
3. Attach your SMTP/Gmail credential to the Email node. Activate.

Add more sources (your CRM, analytics) by extending the Code node the same way.
